name: test-layout
body: The test organization of the root crate: each source module's unit/int tests move to a sibling `tests.rs` (preserving the module path so the `…::tests::unit::` / `…::tests::int::` filters keep working), the e2e tests move to per-source-module top-level `tests/` crates sharing a `tests/common/mod.rs` harness, and the cargo aliases in `.cargo/config.toml` are updated to the new libtest path filters.
